title: Read the following two primary source excerpts and answer the prompt below.

documents.label: A
documents.citation: A. Mitchell Palmer, U.S. Attorney General, "The Case Against the Reds," Records of the Department of Justice, National Archives (archives.gov), February 1920 (National Archives, Record Group 60 (archives.gov), public domain)
documents.excerpt: Each and every adherent of this [communist] movement is a potential murderer or a potential thief… Out of the sly and crafty eyes of many of them leap cupidity, cruelty, insanity, and crime; from their lopsided faces, sloping brows, and misshapen features may be recognized the unmistakable criminal type.

documents.label: B
documents.citation: Bartolomeo Vanzetti, Statement after sentencing, Norfolk County Superior Court, April 9, 1927 (court records, public domain)
documents.excerpt: I am suffering because I am a radical and indeed I am a radical; I have suffered because I was an Italian, and indeed I am an Italian…Not only am I innocent of these two crimes, but in all my life I have never stolen and never killed and never spilled blood.
